messages:
Marta Diaz: Quick sync — we're doing a base-image rebase + cosign key rotation next Tue 03:00 UTC. Primary goals: provenance preserved (SBOM + attestations), KMS key rotation for cosign, and audit events include key_id + image digest.
Riley Cho: 👍 per-env key versions or single infra key? staging should be isolated.
Marta Diaz: plan: one key ring, separate cryptoKeys for staging/prod. prevents accidental cross-use but keeps ops surface small.
Nikhil Rao: Need to fix current RBAC. sec-bot flagged signer SA with cluster-admin bindings last week. Can't rotate until we drop that.
sec-bot: ALERT: signer serviceAccount `cosign-signer@infra` has ClusterRoleBinding -> HIGH. Inventory: https://ci.redwood/inventory/roles/cosign-signer.
Jules (SWE): For runtime checks, we'll require: `signature.kid`, `image.digest`, `attestation.payloadHash` in the audit event. Can we add `rebuild_id` and `canary=true` tags?
ops-oncall: From ops: add a pipeline flag to stop all rebuilds if signer rotation misbehaves. I'll own the kill-switch. quick command: ```bash
curl -X POST $PIPELINE/api/flags -d '{"name":"rebuild_pause","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Riley Cho: RBAC proposal: Role `cosign-signer-limited` in namespace infra-signer with only `get` on `secrets` and a Pod/ServiceAccount binding. I'll post YAML.
Marta Diaz: also need IAM side: bind workload identity to KMS key with limited perms (CryptoKeys.Sign/Verify only) and a condition to only allow the signer SA.
Nikhil Rao: Logging: log-forwarder needs mapping from KMS audit logs -> SIEM. We'll tag events `component:cosign` and include key_version. retention is 400d for keystore events.
sec-bot: RBAC scan queued after proposed changes. Will re-run and post diffs.
Jules (SWE): Canary plan: sign two images in non-prod registry: one signed with new KMS key, one with fallback cosign-local key. Run verifier job that checks attestation and then attempts deploy to a canary nodepool.
Marta Diaz: If verification fails, pipeline pauses (ops kill-switch) and we roll back to previous key/version. Also keep audit trail for postmortem.
Riley Cho: I'll add a preflight check that fails deploy if any signer SA has more than `get` on secrets or any clusterrolebindings. small lint job.
Nikhil Rao: Example ELK query to verify events include kid and digest: ```json
{"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"match":{"event.type":"kms.crypto_sign"}},{"exists":{"field":"signature.kid"}},{"exists":{"field":"image.digest"}}]}}}
```
ops-oncall: I'll prepare runbook snippets (pager flow, how to pause, how to look up key usage in KMS console, quick rollback steps).
Marta Diaz: Assignments: Riley -> RBAC YAML + lint job by Mon EOD. Nikhil -> log-forwarder mapping + SIEM field docs by Mon EOD. Jules -> canary script + verifier by Tue morning. ops-oncall -> kill-switch + runbook. sec-bot -> re-scan after changes.
sec-bot: NOTE: historical finding: two images in prod signed with legacy key v1. Recommend adding migration tag to those artifacts to avoid re-sign loop.
Marta Diaz: Good catch. We'll add migration metadata and include check in verifier to skip re-signing already-migrated images.
Jules (SWE): tiny note: ensure cosign version >= 2.5 in the pipeline to support KMS keyVersion URIs.
Riley Cho: posting RBAC snippet now in thread and PR shortly.
Marta Diaz: Thanks team. Ping #eng-oncall when we start the window. I'll update the runbook page: https://wiki.redwood/internal/rebase-cosign-rotation (comment if missing anything).
